definitions.gloss: slump; losing streak; dry spell; rut
definitions.explanation: A period of poor performance or diminished output, particularly in sports, creative work, or business. From English "slump".

examples.japanese: スランプ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|だっ}した→脱する：28650_dassuru⟧。
examples.english: He got out of his slump.

examples.japanese: ⟦{打撃|だげき}→打撃：12775_dageki⟧スランプ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{打率|だりつ}→打率：07113_daritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: A hitting slump continued and his batting average dropped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{創作|そうさく}→創作：04386_sousaku⟧スランプ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even a veteran writer can fall into a creative slump.

notes:
Used in sports, creative, and business contexts. Commonly appears as a compound modifier (打撃スランプ, 創作スランプ) or standalone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スランプ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|だっ}する→脱する：28650_dassuru⟧: to get out of a slump
- スランプ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into a slump
- スランプ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: slump continues
- スランプ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧: to break out of a slump

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不調|ふちょう}→不調：11303_fuchou⟧: poor condition — more general; can refer to physical condition, machine malfunction, etc.
- ⟦ビハインド→ビハインド：29128_bihaindo⟧: trailing (in score) — refers to current deficit, not a performance trend
